subject: CS351
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 5 Arabic videos. For English, top-tier channels like Gate Smashers and Neso Academy dominated due to their high relevance, quality, and massive view counts. For Arabic, channels like Mustafa S. Aljumaily and Dr. Ahmed Hagag provided excellent, highly-viewed academic lectures. In some cases, broader lectures were chosen over more specific but low-view-count videos, prioritizing peer-validated quality. All topics are covered in both languages.

videos.title: L-3.1: Process Synchronization | Process Types | Race Condition | Operating System-1
videos.topic_en: Race Condition and Critical Section Problem
videos.filter_reason: This Gate Smashers video is a comprehensive introduction with massive peer validation, perfectly explaining race conditions as the motivation for process synchronization.

videos.title: Peterson’s Solution
videos.filter_reason: Neso Academy provides a clear, focused, and highly-viewed explanation of Peterson's solution, making it the best choice for understanding this specific algorithm.

videos.title: L-3.6: Test and Set Instruction in OS | Process Synchronization
videos.filter_reason: From Gate Smashers, this is the most popular and clear explanation of the Test-and-Set instruction, a foundational concept in hardware synchronization.

videos.title: What's Spin Lock? Spin Lock Vs. Mutex.
videos.filter_reason: This video provides a direct and concise comparison of Spinlocks versus Mutexes, which is ideal for students struggling to differentiate these two locking mechanisms.

videos.title: L-3.8: Semaphores | Wait, Signal Operation | Counting Semaphore | Example| Operating system
videos.filter_reason: With over 1.6 million views, this Gate Smashers video is the definitive guide, clearly explaining semaphore operations, types, and providing examples.

videos.title: انظمة التشغيل-24: الفصل الخامس (الجزء الاول) Process Synchronization
videos.topic_en: Race Condition and Critical Section Problem
videos.filter_reason: A highly-viewed and comprehensive lecture that clearly introduces race conditions and the critical section problem, despite incorrect audio language metadata.

videos.title: 16–Operating Systems | Ch6-3 | Solutions to CS Problem | نظم التشغيل | حلول لمشكلة القسم الحرج
videos.filter_reason: This popular video from Dr. Ahmed Hagag covers multiple solutions to the critical section problem, with a clear and well-explained segment on Peterson's solution.

videos.title: Operating Systems - نظم التشغيل - Lecture 6 Part 2\5
videos.filter_reason: This is the best Arabic candidate, as its description explicitly confirms it covers both Test and Set and Compare and Swap with a high view count.

videos.title: انظمة التشغيل-25: الفصل الخامس (الجزء الثاني) Process Synchronization
videos.filter_reason: This is the strongest candidate, covering mutex locks within a broader, highly-viewed lecture on synchronization tools from a reputable channel.

videos.title: نظم التشغيل مزامنة العمليات  Semaphore
videos.filter_reason: With the highest view count by a significant margin, this concise video provides an excellent introduction to semaphores for the Arabic-speaking student.
